info.title: UptimeRobot Universal API
info.description: Manage UptimeRobot monitors, alerts, maintenance windows, and status pages

post.description: Creates a new maintenance window in UptimeRobot.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

value.description: Optional recurrence value for weekly or monthly windows, such as 2-4-5.

type.description: Maintenance window type. Legacy docs: 1 once, 2 daily, 3 weekly, 4 monthly.

start_time.description: Start time. Use Unix time for once windows or HH:mm for repeating windows.
